My student had just received these exam results and he had 6.25 out of 8 total points. I want to adjust those points in a score out of 20. What is the score of my student out of 20?

To adjust the score from 6.25 out of 8 total points to a score out of 20, we can calculate it as follows:

$$
\text{Score out of 20} = \left( \frac{6.25}{8} \right) \times 20
$$

$$
\text{Score out of 20} = 15.625
$$

So, the student's score out of 20 is **15.625**.
